item.title: Version 1.11.1
item.description:
Same numbers everywhere

The menu bar and the window now agree before and after market hours.

  • Positions show the price you're valued at. Last and Change follow the extended-hours setting, like Value and P&L already did.
  • Menu bar percentages match. The ticker, best and worst mover and portfolio notifications measure today's move on the price shown.
  • Same P&L % in the menu and the window. The per-stock list in the menu uses the same calculation as the Positions table, including currency and tax.
